name: Circle Chaos
summary:
circle chaos is a fast-paced vr party game inspired by cube runners, built with gtag-style locomotion for full arm-swing chaos.

jump, climb, launch yourself, and survive through a bunch of different game modes that all play totally differently. whether you’re messing around with friends or trying to lock in and win, it’s pure movement-based mayhem.

gamemodes: 
- horror – not super scary, but huge, fun, and tense in all the right ways
